The people then left Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) alone and left (to consult with each other) but were unable to reach any decision. They then returned to Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) and said, "O Khalifah of Rasulullaah ﷺ! You choose someone on our behalf." "You people may perhaps disagree with my decision," remarked Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). When they assured him that they would not, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) reaffirmed their resolution by saying, "Will you promise in Allaah's name that you would be happy with my decision?" "We certainly will," they confirmed. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) then said, "Then allow me some time to see what is in the best interests of Allaah, His Deen and His servants."
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) later sent for Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) and said, "Recommend someone to me. By Allaah! In my opinion, you are certainly most worthy of the post yourself." When Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) recommended Hadhrat Umar (RA), Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) instructed him to write the letter (of appointment). When Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) reached the point where the name (of the successor) was to be written, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) passed out. When he regained consciousness, he told Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) to write the name of Hadhrat Umar (RA). [^1]
The Reply Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) gave to Hadhrat Talha (RA) Concerning the Appointment of Hadhrat Umar (RA)

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Ubaydullaah bin Abdullaah bin Umar (RA)
blocks.text:
Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Ubaydullaah bin Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) narrates that when Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) was about to pass away, he summoned Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Affaan (RA) and dictated his last testament to him. However, he passed out before he could name his successor. Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) then himself named Hadhrat Umar bin Khattaab (RA). When Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) regained consciousness, he asked Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) whether he had written anyone's name. Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) replied, "I feared that you would not regain consciousness and that the people would then fall into dispute. I therefore wrote the name of Umar bin Khattaab."
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) said, "May Allaah shower His mercies on you. Had you written your name instead, you are certainly worthy of the post." Hadhrat Talha bin Ubaydullaah (RA) then entered and said, "I have been sent to represent those behind me. They are saying that knowing the harshness of Umar during your lifetime, how will he be after your death when you hand over our affairs to him? Allaah will certainly question you about this, so think well what reply you shall give." Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) asked someone to help him sit up and then said, "Do you wish to make me fear Allaah?!
